methodology.name: SPY trend/volatility short exposure proxy
methodology.atr: Wilder20; first TR=high-low; seed=mean first20 TR
methodology.volatility: daily log return EWMA std span60 adjust=False bias=False times sqrt252
methodology.event: short>=25 AND delta5<=0 AND short[t-5]-short[t-10]>0; first qualifying observation then exclude following20 sessions
methodology.study_entry: next session open after signal; horizon h ends close at signal index+h
methodology.study_drawdown: min(0, minimum future close / entry open -1); percent; excludes intraday lows
methodology.baseline: short>=25 AND delta5>0; independently exclude following20 sessions after each selected day
limitations: Observational exploratory study; no causal inference.
Small event counts; horizon samples differ when forward data unavailable.
No transaction costs; price returns exclude distributions.
Proxy exposure of model capital, not actual CTA holdings and not a 0-100 score.
